definition: used to give the opposite view
description: An industrial gym with brick walls, hanging lamps and punching bags. A young man in a navy vest and black shorts stands facing the viewer, lifting a heavy dumbbell in one hand while he holds a chocolate doughnut in the other. He keeps curling the dumbbell but stares at the doughnut with a doubtful, unsure face, as if weighing up the two. Behind him a young woman in a sports top and a young man in a white T-shirt train and move around.

taps.phrase: to stare at a chocolate doughnut

taps.target: the man in the white T-shirt
